scope: Tushare U.S. daily source inspection as a possible consolidated-volume alternative
mode: source inspection and reconciliation only; no strategy research inputs or publication
request_rule: First symbol tests endpoint access; stop that endpoint after permission/error response. Only the declared five sessions and ten frozen symbols.
price_rule: Keep original prices/factor untouched; adjusted endpoint documentation says price times factor yields adjusted price
volume_rule: Keep source values unchanged; no A-share lot-unit assumption or inferred scaling

reuse_reviews.decision: No registered Tushare asset found; inspect existing optional adapter/token reader, preserve registered assets
Existing audited raw-volume provider remains authoritative; this probe does not replace it
Reuse bounded verified HTTPS reader; native GET fallback is disabled for token-bearing POST

credentials: Existing configured token read only in memory; never retained in requests/receipts or logs
retention: Local raw source responses and exact token-free request receipts; no licensed rows in Git
